name: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
description: A handbook of agile software craftsmanship covering naming, functions, error handling, and refactoring.

name: Effective Java
author: Joshua Bloch
description: Best practices for the Java platform, including generics, concurrency, serialization, and object creation.

name: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann
description: The big ideas behind reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems, replication, partitioning, and stream processing.

name: Java Concurrency in Practice
author: Brian Goetz
description: Thread safety, executors, task execution, liveness, performance, and testing concurrent Java programs.

name: Refactoring
author: Martin Fowler
description: Improving the design of existing code through structured transformations and code smell identification.

name: Domain-Driven Design
author: Eric Evans
description: Tackling complexity in the heart of software using bounded contexts, aggregates, entities, and domain events.
